title: A PR names its objective: the objective trailer, the PR view's Objective section and the objective-focus check (ADR-0048)
acceptance_criteria: a range whose commits carry objective: renders the bead, its plan progress, its touched components and the knowledge governing them; objective-focus warns on mixed objectives, unattributed files and unknown ids; a range that names none renders as before

title: Agents claim one objective per session: a SessionStart hook and the nugit skill rule (ADR-0048)
acceptance_criteria: nugit objective claim records a branch's objective and refuses a second; the commit-msg hook names the claimed objective; nugit hook session-start tells each session its objective or how to claim one; agent -install -hook installs it and doctor reports it

title: nugit orphans: report abandoned objectives, stopped sessions, stray branches and unpromoted findings (ADR-0048)
acceptance_criteria: nugit orphans lists stalled objectives, stopped sessions holding an open objective, closed beads with work left on a branch, stray branches, merged leftovers and stale notes, each with the finish-or-drop choice; squash-merged branches are not reported as unmerged
